row.team_price_text: Core: $19/mo per Workspace (1 full seat), extra full seats $39/mo each, billed yearly
row.evidence: Webflow's pricing table marks SSO, JIT provisioning, SCIM and the Audit logs API for Enterprise only, and its help centre says SSO must be enabled "for your Enterprise Workspace before you can configure SCIM provisioning."
row.notes: Still gated on Enterprise (Talk to us). Pricing now has Site plans (Starter free, Basic $15/mo, Premium $25/mo, billed yearly), Platform plans (Team $2,500/mo, annual contract, no SSO/SCIM; Enterprise custom) and Workspace plans (Starter free, Core $19/mo, Growth $49/mo, billed yearly). Workspace plans include 1 full seat; extra full seats are $39/mo and limited seats $15/mo, billed yearly, so the per-user team price is now recorded as the $39 full-seat price (June recorded the $19 Core Workspace fee). SCIM requires Enterprise SSO, is set up by Webflow Enterprise Support with custom instructions, syncs first name, last name and email, frees the seat on deprovisioning, and does not support role or group assignment. Workspace member and audit-log APIs are Enterprise-only. Okta OIN app is SWA only.

limitations.text: Once SCIM is on, adding or removing users is no longer possible in Webflow's dashboard; the IdP is the only source.
Setup instructions (base URL, token) are provided privately by Enterprise Support or Customer Success, not published.
